theater: 上海閘北廟行至吳淞戰線

battle.name: 一二八事變
battle.theater: 上海閘北廟行至吳淞戰線
battle.brief: 一九三一年秋九一八事變後，上海商界抵制日貨，日本關東軍策劃「假戰爭」轉移視線；一九三二年一月二十八日夜，日軍突襲閘北，第十九路軍與第五軍死守至吳淞一線，三月三日局部停戰。卡面八九式戰車是日本陸軍首種國產量產中型戰車，開戰後由戰車部隊拉上火線，在閘北與廟行的突破中提供唯一的裝甲衝擊力。

kit.name: 八九式戰車
kit.history: 作為日本帝國陸軍首款大規模生產的中型戰車，於1932年的一二八事變中投入上海戰場，提供機動火力支援。

countries: 交戰方是中華民國與大日本帝國，交火侷限在上海及周邊，雙方都沒有把這場衝突升格為全面戰爭。中方守軍主力是國民革命軍第十九路軍，由廣東調來，隸屬國民政府軍事委員會，軍長蔣光鼐、黨代表戴季陶，轄第二師（師長蔡廷鍇）、第八十三師（師長區壽年）等部，防守閘北至吳淞之間的市區與鄉野；南京方面隨後派第五軍（軍長張治中，轄第八十七師、第八十八師等）接防右翼，進駐江灣、大場、陳家橋一線，形成左翼第十九路軍、右翼第五軍的兩段式防禦，另有九一八事變後流亡關內的馮庸大學學生組成東北抗日義勇軍參加戰鬥。日方進攻主力是日本陸軍上海派遣軍，司令官先後為鹽澤幸一、白川義兵衛，一九三二年二月白川在上海被刺身亡後由植田謙吉接任，地面部隊以步兵聯隊為骨幹，並由海軍特別陸上部擔任沿黃浦江與閘北的突擊；作戰支援由海軍航空隊與大日本航空的機隊，以及長江口、黃浦江上的巡洋艦與驅逐艦提供。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were the Republic of China and the Empire of Japan, and the fighting was confined to Shanghai and its surroundings; neither side escalated the clash into a general war. On the Chinese side the main garrison was the 19th Route Army of the National Revolutionary Army, transferred in from Guangdong and subordinate to the National Government's Military Affairs Commission, with Chiang Kuang-nai as army commander and Tai Chi-t'ao as party representative. It comprised the 2nd Division under Tsai T'ing-k'ai and the 83rd Division under Ch'ou Shou-nien among others, and it held the built-up area and the open country between Zhabei and Wusong. Nanjing then sent the 5th Army, commanded by Chang Chih-chung and containing the 87th and 88th Divisions, to take over the right flank around Jiangwan, Dachang and Chenchiaochiao, so that the front ended up split into the 19th Route Army on the left and the 5th Army on the right; the Northeastern Volunteer Force, raised by students of the exiled Feng-yung University after the September 18 Incident, also took part. The Japanese attacking force was the Shanghai Expeditionary Army of the Imperial Japanese Army, commanded first by Shiozawa Kōichi and then by Shirakawa Yoshinori, who was assassinated in Shanghai in February 1932, after which Ueda Kenkichi took over. The Japanese ground troops were built around infantry regiments, with the naval special landing force responsible for the assault along the Huangpu River and in Zhabei, while support came from the naval air service and the aircraft of Dai Nippon Airways, together with the cruisers and destroyers lying at the mouth of the Yangtze and on the Huangpu.
people: 中方決策與指揮鏈條上有南京的蔣中正，他在一二八事變中授權上海方面自行應戰，以免戰事擴大；前線則由蔣光鼐以第十九路軍軍長身份統率全局，蔡廷鍇以第二師師長身份在最激烈的閘北、廟行一線直接指揮突擊與反突擊，區壽年率第八十三師扼守廟行、姚家角方向的關鍵陣地，張治中率第五軍自南京兼程趕到，接手右翼並把防線從閘北推到江灣、大場；上海市長吳鐵城在華界組織市區守備、人員疏散與救護，馮庸率東北抗日義勇軍在北線活動。日本方面的關鍵人物是關東軍參謀板垣征四郎，他自一九三一年秋策劃在上海製造一場「假戰爭」以轉移國際聯盟對東北的注意，並電召上海特務機關長田中隆吉，撥給二萬日元特務經費，田中再交予川島芳子；東京方面由木戶幸一、近衛文麿、牧野伸顯組成的「十一人俱樂部」以需要一個「思考間歇」為名支持此策。上海派遣軍方面，鹽澤幸一在開戰前主持軍事部署，白川義兵衛在一九三二年二月二十八日於虹口被刺身亡，兇手身分有童子團、便衣等說法，刺殺的直接後果是停戰談判被推遲而援軍繼續抵滬；植田謙吉其後接任派遣軍司令官。公共租界工部局與英、美、法等各國領事居間斡旋，一九三二年三月三日局部停戰得以達成。
peopleEn: On the Chinese side of the chain of decision sat Chiang Kai-shek in Nanjing, who during the incident authorised the Shanghai authorities to fight it out on their own so that the war would not spread. On the front line Chiang Kuang-nai directed the whole affair as commander of the 19th Route Army, Tsai T'ing-k'ai commanded the 2nd Division directly in the fiercest fighting around Zhabei and Miaohang, ordering assaults and counter-assaults, Ch'ou Shou-nien led the 83rd Division on the key positions facing Miaohang and Yaochiachiao, and Chang Chih-chung brought the 5th Army up from Nanjing in double time, took over the right flank and pushed the line back from Zhabei to Jiangwan and Dachang. Wu T'ieh-ch'eng, mayor of Shanghai, organised the defence of the Chinese city, the evacuation of personnel and relief work on the Chinese side of the wall, while Feng-yung commanded the Northeastern Volunteer Force on the northern flank. The decisive figure on the Japanese side was Itagaki Seishiro, a staff officer of the Kwantung Army who from the autumn of 1931 planned a false war in Shanghai to divert the League of Nations' attention from the northeast. He summoned Tanaka Ryukichi, head of the Shanghai secret service, allocated him twenty thousand yen of secret funds, and Tanaka passed the same sum to Kawashima Yoshiko. In Tokyo the so-called Club of Eleven, formed by Kido Kanki, Konoe Fumimaro and Makino Nobuyoshi, backed the scheme under the name of a thinking interval. On the Shanghai side, Shiozawa Kōichi directed the military preparations before the fighting began, and Shirakawa Yoshinori was assassinated in Hongkou on 28 February 1932; the identity of the assassin is reported variously as a boy scout, a plain-clothes man and others, and the immediate consequence of the killing was that the truce talks were delayed while reinforcements kept arriving. Ueda Kenkichi succeeded him as commander of the expeditionary army. The Municipal Council of the International Settlement and the consular representatives of Britain, the United States and France mediated, and a local ceasefire was reached on 3 March 1932.
kits: 卡面兵器八九式戰車是日本陸軍第一種國產制式量產戰車，昭和三年（一九二八）三月由陸軍技術本部第四研究所開始設計，參考英國維卡克斯C型中戰車，容量約十噸級，四月訂出設計要目，八月完成概略設計圖並下交大阪砲兵工廠，一九二九年四月製成第一號試作車；量產由三菱航空機承擔，一九二九年十二月新設大井工廠，滿洲事變後日本製鋼所、神戸製鋼所與汽車製造株式會社亦加入生產。諸元方面八九式分甲、乙兩型：甲型全長五點七五公尺、寬二點一八公尺、高二點五六公尺，自重十一點九噸、全備十二點七噸；乙型全長五點七零公尺，自重十二點二噸、全備十三點零噸；乘員四人，採葉片式懸掛，裝甲最大十七公厘，主砲為九〇式五糎七戰車砲一門、備彈一百發，副武裝為九一式車載輕機槍兩挺、備彈二千七百四十五發。甲型用東京瓦斯電氣工業水冷直列六缸汽油機一百匹馬力，乙型改用三菱A六一二〇VD空冷直列六缸柴油機；整地最高速度每小時二十五公里、巡航二十公里，不整地僅八至十二公里，行動距離甲型約一百四十公里、乙型約一百七十公里。總產量一般認為在二百輛上下，另有少數改裝型，諸說並存。日軍同場還有步兵三八式步槍、三八式輕機槍、九四式擲彈筒、七十毫米連隊砲與艦砲支援；中方第十九路軍裝備以漢陽八八式步槍為主，配二七式重機槍、輕機槍、八二式迫擊砲、擲彈筒與手榴彈，沒有制式戰車，車輛與運輸靠人力車、馬車、民船以及滬寧、滬杭兩條鐵路維持。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card, the Type 89 I-Go, was the first domestically designed and mass-produced standard tank of the Imperial Japanese Army. Development began in March 1928 in the Fourth Research Section of the Army Technical Bureau, taking the British Vickers C-type medium tank as a reference and setting a weight class of roughly ten tonnes; the design specification was fixed in April, preliminary drawings were completed in August and handed to the Osaka Arsenal, and the first prototype was finished in April 1929. Series production was taken on by Mitsubishi Aircraft, which built a new tank works at Oi in December 1929; after the Manchurian Incident the Japan Steel Works, Kobe Steel Works and Nissan Motor also joined in. In specification the Type 89 came in two forms, the A and B models. The A model was 5.75 metres long, 2.18 metres wide and 2.56 metres high, weighing 11.9 tonnes empty and 12.7 tonnes in fighting order; the B model was 5.70 metres long, weighing 12.2 tonnes empty and 13.0 tonnes in fighting order. The crew was four, the suspension was of the leaf-spring type, and the armour reached a maximum of 17 millimetres. The main armament was one Type 90 37-millimetre tank gun with one hundred rounds, and the secondary armament was two Type 91 vehicle-mounted light machine guns with 2,745 rounds. The A model used a 100-horsepower water-cooled inline six-cylinder petrol engine from Tokyo Gas Electric Industry, while the B model switched to the Mitsubishi A6120VD air-cooled inline six-cylinder diesel. Maximum speed on the level was 25 kilometres per hour and cruising speed 20, falling to only 8 to 12 kilometres per hour over broken ground, with a range of about 140 kilometres for the A model and 170 for the B. Total output is generally put at around two hundred vehicles, with a few converted types, and the figures vary between sources. The Japanese army also fought here with Type 38 infantry rifles, Type 38 light machine guns, Type 94 grenade dischargers, 70-millimetre regimental guns and naval gunfire. The 19th Route Army on the Chinese side was armed mainly with Hanyang Type 88 rifles, together with Type 27 heavy machine guns, light machine guns, Type 82 mortars, grenade dischargers and hand grenades; it had no standard tank of its own, and transport and supply rested on rickshaws, carts, native boats and the two railways running to Nanking and Hangchow.
tactics: 一月二十八日夜，上海派遣軍以海軍特別陸部隊與步兵聯隊在閘北的寶山路、廣肇公所一帶突然發火，目標是北站、華界巡捕房與租界邊緣的工部局水廠，企圖以奪取制高點切斷中國守軍的縱深；中方第十九路軍依托租界邊沿的鋼筋混凝土樓房、街壘與巷道逐街抵抗，日軍每推進一條街都要清剿殘敵，白日攻擊多被頂住，入夜後中方以小隊滲透、擲彈筒與手榴彈襲擊日軍陣地與交通線。到月底，日軍把主攻方向轉向西北面的廟行、紀家廟與楊行一線，中方在廟行鎮、姚家角、龍家宅一線築壘固守，雙方在公路與村落間反覆拉鋸，八九式戰車就是在這一階段被投入，以步兵支撐下沿主要馬路推進，用車體撞破路障與街壘，掩護步兵佔領陣地。第五軍抵達後，戰線右移至江灣、大場、陳家橋，中方在此築第二道縱深工事，組織交叉火力與預備隊反衝擊；日軍則以海軍艦砲沿黃浦江與長江口支援，並以飛機對閘北與市郊陣地反覆掃射，控制制空權。守方沒有反戰車砲，對八九式的手段只有迫擊砲曲射、步兵近距離攻擊加上路障、地雷與橋梁破壞，日軍車輛因此多限於在縱深開闊地與主干道上活動，難以越過上海街巷的狹窄與橋梁的承重限制。三月初雙方在吳淞、大場、廟行一線再行爭奪後，經公共租界工部局與各國領事居間斡旋，於三月三日達成局部停戰。
tacticsEn: On the night of 28 January the Shanghai Expeditionary Army opened fire without warning in the Zhabei district around Pao-shan Road and the Kwang-chao Public Hall, using the naval special landing force and infantry regiments against the northern station, the Chinese city police posts and the Municipal Council waterworks at the edge of the International Settlement, in the hope that seizing the high ground would cut the Chinese defenders off from their rear. The 19th Route Army fought street by street from the reinforced-concrete blocks, barricades and alleyways along the boundary of the concessions; every street the Japanese took had to be cleared of remnants, their daylight attacks were usually held, and by night Chinese platoons infiltrated to throw grenades and mortar bombs at Japanese positions and lines of communication. By the end of the month the Japanese turned their main effort to the north-west, against Miaohang, Chichiachiao and Yanghang, while the Chinese entrenched at Miaohang, Yaochiachiao and Lungchiachai, and the two sides fought a seesaw battle along the roads and between the villages. This was the phase in which the Type 89 I-Go was committed: moving along the main roads under infantry support, it used its hull to smash through roadblocks and street barricades while covering the infantry as they occupied positions. After the 5th Army arrived the line shifted right to Jiangwan, Dachang and Chenchiaochiao, where the Chinese built a second line of depth works, organised interlocking fire and counter-attacked with reserves. The Japanese supported themselves with naval gunfire along the Huangpu River and at the mouth of the Yangtze, and made repeated air raids against the Zhabei positions and the outskirts of the city, holding the air. The defenders had no anti-tank gun, and their only answers to the Type 89 were curved mortar fire, close-range infantry attack, roadblocks, mines and the destruction of bridges; Japanese vehicles were therefore largely confined to open ground in depth and to the main avenues, and had difficulty passing the narrow lanes of Shanghai and the load limits of its bridges. After further fighting along Wusong, Dachang and Miaohang in early March, the local ceasefire of 3 March was reached through the mediation of the Municipal Council of the International Settlement and the foreign consular representatives.
data: 兵力與傷亡的數字，通行說法是中方出動約四萬二千人、日方約七萬七千人，但雙方的統計口徑不同，引用時須存疑；中方記錄的軍人傷亡約一萬四千一百零四人，日軍死傷約五千零九十二人，這是各界引用最廣的一組數字。戰役自一九三二年一月二十八日開火至三月三日局部停戰，歷時三十五日。八九式戰車的諸元如前述，總產量約二百輛上下。八九式之外，日軍在上海以步兵聯隊、海軍特別陸部隊與航空兵部隊作戰，兵力在停戰前不斷由本土與滿洲增援。背景數據亦可對照：一九三〇年上海每月平均進口總額有百分之二十九來自日本商品，到一九三一年十二月降至百分之三；一九三一年七月至一九三二年三月底，上海日商的損失總額達四千一百二十萬四千日元，日清輪船公司的輪船全部停航。關東軍撥給田中隆吉的特務經費是二萬日元，其後同樣數額交予川島芳子。關鍵時間點依序為：一九三一年七月十三日上海各界召開反日援僑大會，九月十八日九一八事變，十月一日田中隆吉抵滬，十月五日日本內閣會議決定提出強硬警告，一九三二年一月國聯調查團成立，一月十八日日僧事件，一月二十八日夜開火，二月二十八日白川義兵衛被刺，三月三日局部停戰，五月五日《上海停戰協定》簽訂，同年十月國聯調查團報告發表。
dataEn: On strength and casualties, the figures most commonly cited are about 42,000 men committed on the Chinese side and about 77,000 on the Japanese side, but the counting conventions of the two sides differ and the numbers should be treated with caution. Chinese records put military casualties at about 14,104 and Japanese dead and wounded at about 5,092, and this is the set of numbers most widely quoted. The campaign ran from the opening of fire on 28 January 1932 to the local ceasefire of 3 March, a span of thirty-five days. The specification of the Type 89 I-Go has been given above, and total output was around two hundred vehicles. Alongside it, the Japanese fought in Shanghai with infantry regiments, the naval special landing force and air units, and their strength was reinforced continuously from the home islands and from Manchuria up to the moment of the ceasefire. The background figures can be checked as well: in 1930 an average of 29 per cent of Shanghai's monthly import total came from Japanese goods, and by December 1931 that had fallen to 3 per cent. Between July 1931 and the end of March 1932 Japanese merchants in Shanghai recorded losses totalling 41,204,000 yen, and the ships of the Shanghai Steam Navigation Company all stopped sailing. The secret funds the Kwantung Army allocated to Tanaka Ryukichi came to 20,000 yen, and the same sum was then handed to Kawashima Yoshiko. The key dates in order are: 13 July 1931, when various circles in Shanghai held a mass meeting to support overseas Chinese and boycott Japan; 18 September, the September 18 Incident; 1 October, the arrival of Tanaka Ryukichi in Shanghai; 5 October, the Japanese cabinet meeting deciding on a strong warning; January 1932, the formation of the League of Nations commission of inquiry; 18 January, the incident involving a Japanese monk; the night of 28 January, when the fighting began; 28 February, the assassination of Shirakawa Yoshinori; 3 March, the local ceasefire; 5 May, the signature of the Shanghai Truce Agreement; and October of the same year, the publication of the report of the League of Nations commission.
cause: 起因有遠因也有近因。遠因是滿洲事變之後日本在國際上陷於孤立，關東軍需要一場別處的衝突來轉移國際聯盟對東北的注意；關東軍參謀部一九三一年九月二十二日制定《滿蒙問題解決方案》，板垣征四郎其後在東京策劃在上海製造一場「假戰爭」，並由上海特務機關長田中隆吉以收買、煽動的方式製造騷動，東京的「十一人俱樂部」則以需要一個「思考間歇」來解釋此舉。近因是上海方面的社會與經濟衝突：一九三一年七月萬寶山事件之後，朝鮮總督府壓迫朝鮮華僑，上海各界在七月十三日召開反日援僑大會；九一八事變後商界抵制中日貿易，日商航運與進口受到重創，日本政府在一九三一年十月五日內閣會議上決定由外務省向國民政府提出強硬警告，陸軍省、海軍省與外務省更在一九三二年一月六日聯名制定《中國問題處理綱要》。直接導火線是一九三二年一月的日僧事件：一名日本僧侶在上海與中國人發生衝突而受傷，日本方面提出強硬照會，要求國民政府道歉、賠償並懲凶，上海市政府一度照辦，日方仍不接受；同時第十九路軍奉命由閩贛移駐上海，蔣光鼐在閘北與吳淞之間構築防線，日方的情報與特務活動又直接針對這支防軍，最後由上海派遣軍自行下令越過停戰線向中國守軍發動攻擊，把一場外交糾紛變成全面戰鬥。
causeEn: The outbreak had both distant and immediate causes. The distant cause was Japan's isolation after the Manchurian Incident: the Kwantung Army needed a conflict elsewhere to divert the attention of the League of Nations from the northeast. On 22 September 1931 the Kwantung Army staff drew up the Plan for Solving the Manchurian and Mongolian Problem, and Itagaki Seishiro later planned in Tokyo for a false war to be staged in Shanghai, with Tanaka Ryukichi, head of the Shanghai secret service, buying and inciting people to create disturbances, while the Club of Eleven in Tokyo explained the move as the thinking interval Japan needed. The immediate cause lay in social and economic friction in Shanghai. After the Wanbaoshan incident of July 1931 the Government-General of Korea began pressing on Korean residents abroad, and various circles in Shanghai held a mass meeting to support them on 13 July; after the September 18 Incident the business community boycotted Sino-Japanese trade and Japanese shipping and imports were badly hit, and on 5 October 1931 the Japanese cabinet decided to have the Foreign Ministry deliver a strong warning to the National Government, while the Army, Navy and Foreign Ministries jointly drew up the Outline for Handling the China Problem on 6 January 1932. The spark was the incident involving a Japanese monk in January 1932: a Japanese monk was injured in a clash with Chinese in Shanghai, Japan submitted a strong demand for apology, compensation and punishment, and the Shanghai municipal government for a time complied, but the Japanese side would not accept it. At the same time the 19th Route Army was moved from Fujian and Jiangxi to Shanghai, and Chiang Kuang-nai built a line between Zhabei and Wusong; Japanese intelligence and secret-service activity was directed precisely at this covering force. In the end the Shanghai Expeditionary Army gave the order itself to cross the demarcation line and attack the Chinese defenders, turning a diplomatic quarrel into a full-scale battle.
impact: 一二八事變在軍事上是一場雙方都沒有取得決定的有限衝突，在政治與國際層面卻掀動了整個遠東。第一，三月三日局部停戰與五月五日《上海停戰協定》之後，上海劃為非軍事區，第十九路軍被調離原防區移往福建，第五軍接管防務，長江口的門戶在制度上就此敞開，這條條款在後來的反覆爭議中一直被援引。第二，國際聯盟調查團（李頓爵士率團）於一九三二年十月發表報告，認定日本為侵略者、滿洲國不合法，中國政府拒絕接受，等於把日本在國際上的孤立進一步固定下來，也促使英美在輿論與貸款上轉向支持中國；日本則加速在東北扶植滿洲國，把注意力重新拉回北方。第三，事件在中國國內成為抗日救亡運動的符號，第十九路軍的抵抗被寫進歌曲與文學，一九三五年聶耳作曲的《義勇軍進行曲》即以此為背景傳唱，後來成為抗日戰爭時期最著名的軍歌之一；參戰將領如蔡廷鍇在次年福建事變中舉兵抗日，說明這一役留下的不只是戰史記憶。第四，裝備層面，八九式戰車在上海的實戰讓日本陸軍確認中型戰車的價值，量產與改型持續推進，乙型改用柴油機的改裝工作隨後展開，該型車在一九三三年察哈爾與萬里長城方向的作戰中再度投入，成為日本陸軍機械化的開端；中方則由此更重視裝甲部隊的建設，其後陸續自蘇聯與德國取得輕型戰車與裝甲車，在中央軍中組建裝甲單位，這條路線日後匯入全面抗戰的機械化作戰。
impactEn: Militarily the incident was a limited conflict in which neither side achieved a decision, but politically and internationally it shook the whole Far East. First, after the local ceasefire of 3 March and the Shanghai Truce Agreement of 5 May, Shanghai was declared a demilitarized zone: the 19th Route Army was pulled out of its sector and sent to Fujian, the 5th Army took over the defence, and the gateway at the mouth of the Yangtze was opened by treaty, a clause that was invoked repeatedly in later disputes. Second, the League of Nations commission of inquiry under Lord Lytton reported in October 1932 that Japan was the aggressor and that Manchukuo was illegal; the Chinese government refused to accept the report, which fixed Japan's international isolation more firmly and pushed Britain and the United States towards supporting China in public opinion and in credit, while Japan hurried to build up Manchukuo in the north and pulled attention back that way. Third, inside China the incident became a symbol of the national movement to resist Japan and save the nation: the resistance of the 19th Route Army was written into songs and literature, and the March of the Volunteers composed by Nie Er in 1935 grew out of this background and later became one of the best known army songs of the war of resistance; commanders such as Tsai T'ing-k'ai, who had fought here, rose in arms against Japan in the Fujian incident of the following year, showing that the affair left behind more than a memory in military history. Fourth, in terms of equipment, the combat debut of the Type 89 in Shanghai convinced the Japanese army of the value of the medium tank: production and modification continued, the conversion of the B model to a diesel engine followed, and the type was committed again in the Chahar and Great Wall fighting of 1933, marking the start of Japanese mechanization. China, for its part, took the lesson to heart and gave more attention to armoured formations, subsequently importing light tanks and armoured cars from the Soviet Union and Germany and raising armoured units within the Central Army, a line that later fed into the mechanized warfare of the full-scale war of resistance.
result: 結果是有限停戰，而不是任何一方取得決定性勝利。一九三二年二月下旬至三月初，戰事在吳淞、大場、廟行一線反覆爭奪，二月二十八日上海派遣軍司令白川義兵衛在虹口被刺身亡，兇手身分眾說紛紜，刺殺反而使日方增兵、談判延宕。三月三日，雙方在公共租界工部局與英、美、法等各國領事居間斡旋下達成局部停戰，戰線大致回到吳淞、廟行以北；五月五日《上海停戰協定》正式簽訂，規定上海非軍事化、中國軍隊不得駐紮原防區、第十九路軍調離。日軍在東北的推進則未受牽制，一九三二年三月一日溥儀在長春就任，滿洲國成立；國際聯盟的調查報告於十月發表，認定日本為侵略者，卻未能阻止任何一方的既成事實。對八九式戰車而言，這一役是它第一次真正投入大規模實戰：它證明了中型戰車在攻堅與支援步兵上的作用，也暴露了裝甲車隊在狹窄街巷、密集障礙與缺乏空中掩護時的侷限。
resultEn: The outcome was a limited ceasefire rather than a decisive victory for anyone. From late February to the beginning of March 1932 the fighting was fought over again along Wusong, Dachang and Miaohang, and on 28 February Shirakawa Yoshinori, commander of the Shanghai Expeditionary Army, was assassinated in Hongkou; the identity of the assassin is reported in many ways, and the killing only prompted Japanese reinforcement and delayed the talks. On 3 March, through the mediation of the Municipal Council of the International Settlement and the consular representatives of Britain, the United States and France, the two sides reached a local ceasefire and the line fell back roughly to the north of Wusong and Miaohang; the Shanghai Truce Agreement was formally signed on 5 May, providing for the demilitarization of Shanghai, forbidding Chinese troops from remaining in their old positions and ordering the 19th Route Army away. Japanese advance in the northeast was not held up in any way: on 1 March 1932 P'u Yi took office at Changchun and Manchukuo was established, and the League of Nations report published in October identified Japan as the aggressor while stopping none of the accomplished facts on either side. For the Type 89 I-Go this campaign was its first real commitment in large-scale combat. It demonstrated the value of the medium tank for assaulting positions and supporting infantry, and at the same time exposed the limitations of armoured formations in narrow streets, among dense obstacles and without air cover.
